title: Shots static data contract (docs/static-api.md), schema 1
description: One definition per published file: validate data/<name>.json against #/$defs/<name>. Objects are closed (additionalProperties false) so nothing outside the contract, such as odds or source columns, can be published unnoticed.

explain.description: Additive (schema 1). Why the expected total is what it is: an exact additive decomposition of the fitted model for this fixture (shots.models.explain). baseline.value + sum(factors[].effect) + residual = expected_mean, exactly, in tenths of a shot. Stored with the prediction; never contains an odds value.

expected_mean.description: Mean of the published total-shots distribution, one decimal (the fixture's `expected` is its integer median).

factors.description: At most six named factors of at least 0.2 shots, sorted by absolute effect, then at most one entry `other` (all smaller factors combined).

effect.description: Shots added (+) or removed (-) by this factor, one decimal, never 0.

residual.description: Rounding remainder so that the published numbers add up exactly; at most a few tenths.

home_matches.description: Prior matches behind the home side's form (domestic matches for cross-border fixtures).

odds_used.description: Whether the odds-aware model scored the fixture (equals the fixture's `odds`). A flag, never an odds value.

home_volatility.description: Reserved. Always null today: a team's recent volatility was found not to predict its future spread, so no label is published.

model_gap.description: Expected mean of the odds model minus that of the no-odds model for this fixture (shots, one decimal); null when the fixture was scored without odds.

surge_labels.description: Additive (schema 1). Surge Watch: which over-shoot patterns of the research (surge.json) this fixture matches, known before kick-off. Labels only: the fixture's probabilities are unchanged. Present only when the fixture was assessed (domestic, scored by the production model of its route); lists may be empty.

signals.description: Boost signals (ids of surge.json signals with direction boost) that apply on the fixture's route, catalogue order; at most one season-end signal.

against.description: Damper signals (direction damper) that apply on the fixture's route, catalogue order.

strong.description: Additive (schema 1). Present (true) only for a strong surge candidate: stacking.min_boosts or more signals AND the catalogue allows the label on the fixture's route (surge.json stacking.routes.<route>.strong_applies).

stack_cell.description: Research numbers of one group of matches (by number of signals or by season phase); an empty group has only n.

table_side.description: Additive (schema 1). One team's league table before the match (our own computation from results dated strictly before it).

pos.description: League position, 1 = top (points, then goal difference); null before the team's first game.

left.description: Scheduled games left (format-aware); null for playoff formats.

to_top.description: Leader's points minus own (0 = level with or leading).

to_safety.description: Own points minus those of the best-placed team in the drop zone (bottom round(15% of the league) places); <= 0 = in the drop zone.

table_context.description: Additive (schema 1). Table position and season period of a fixture assessed by Surge Watch, before kick-off. Context only: never changes a probability.

phase.description: The signals' own definition (shots.evaluation.surge_rules): run_in (a team has 6 or fewer league games left), else late (>= 2/3 of the scheduled games played), middle (>= 25%), early. Playoff formats: by the regular-season share, playoff rounds = late, never run_in. null when progress is unknown.

surge_route_stats.description: The research's own numbers for one signal on one route (copied from reports/2026-10-26_overshoot_patterns.json, never recomputed).

over_rate.description: Share that ended 5+ shots above our expected total.

stated_rate.description: What our own published curves gave for the same event on the same matches.

base_rate.description: The same share over all matches of the route ('usual').

excess_ci.description: 95% interval of over_rate - stated_rate (day-block bootstrap; pooled signals: normal approximation).

seasons_held.description: Seasons (with 20+ matches) in which the difference had the signal's direction.

applies.description: Whether fixtures on this route are labelled with the signal (interval excludes 0 and held in enough seasons).

accuracy_point.description: Additive (schema 1). Accuracy of one day (match date, venue-local) or one week (date = its Monday, venue-local match dates). matches / mae / bias / floor80_held: the settled matches, one prediction per match by the results.json rule (the last pre-match board prediction); mae = mean |actual - expected|, bias = mean (expected - actual) (positive = more shots expected than played), floor80_held = share of matches with actual >= lb 80; null when the group has no such match. by_n: exactly the thresholds of the record's by_n; picks = the record's settled picks (same view, published P(total >= N) >= 0.70) in the group, hits = those that reached N. A group can have picks but matches 0 (no settled board prediction).

provisional.description: Additive (schema 1). How many of `matches` are settled by a provisional result (not yet confirmed by football-data).

void.description: Additive (schema 1): picks whose match has no shots data.

provisional.description: Additive (schema 1): how many of the settled picks are settled by a provisional result (not yet confirmed by football-data).

daily.description: Additive (schema 1). The 30 most recent days with at least one settled match, oldest first.

weekly.description: Additive (schema 1). The 52 most recent weeks (Monday to Sunday) with at least one settled match, oldest first.

last_job.description: The last finished `python -m shots update` run; null when the database has never recorded one.

team.description: null when the board has no team predictions.

leagues.description: Every league referenced by board.json, results.json or track.json; fixtures = upcoming fixtures on the board (0 when the league only appears in results or the track record).

featured.description: Additive (schema 1). Present (true) only for competitions the site pins first (the UEFA Champions League); absent otherwise.

provisional_results.description: Additive (schema 1): rows in results.json with result_status provisional.

record.description: Additive (schema 1). since = insert time of the earliest pre-match prediction in the database behind this export; it moves forward if that database had to be rebuilt (the live record then restarts).

awaiting_results.description: Additive (schema 1). Matches with a pre-match prediction that had finished by the latest board run but have no result yet (last 30 days), official and experimental apart; oldest = the earliest such match date.

model_history.description: Additive (schema 1). Model milestones dated on or before the export day, oldest first (committed file src/shots/export/model_history.json).

odds.description: Whether the odds-aware model scored this fixture. A flag, never an odds value.

experimental.description: Additive (schema 1). Present (true) only when the fixture was scored by an experimental model (cross-border competitions: built from each club's domestic form, calibration on the competition unknown, never settled). Absent = an ordinary prediction.

data_quality.description: Additive (schema 1). Only with experimental: how many of the two clubs had domestic shot data: full = both, partial = one (the other is a neutral stand-in, wider bounds), none = neither. Absent = full for ordinary fixtures.

result_source.description: Additive (schema 1). Where the actual counts come from: football-data (automatic), manual (entered by hand from a public match page, for competitions without an automatic source) or, for a provisional result, the provider's name (the host label of source_url, e.g. espn).

result_status.description: Additive (schema 1). provisional = entered by hand from source_url because football-data has not published the match yet; it is replaced by football-data's numbers when they arrive (then confirmed, result_source football-data). confirmed = the competition's own source (football-data, or the manual results of a competition without an automatic source).

source_url.description: Additive (schema 1). Only with a manual or provisional result: the page the counts were read from.

experimental.description: Additive (schema 1). Present (true) only for an experimental prediction (cross-border competitions); such results are never part of the official live record. Absent = an ordinary prediction.

surge.description: Additive (schema 1). The Surge Watch labels this fixture carried in the pre-match board run its prediction comes from, exactly as recorded then (the catalogue of that day; clients ignore unknown ids). Absent when that run did not assess it (labels started 2026-10-27).

backfill.description: null when the database has no backfill run.

live.description: The official record: live picks saved before kick-off (v_official_picks).

experimental.description: Additive (schema 1). Experimental predictions (cross-border competitions) settled by manual results (v_experimental_picks); never part of the official record.

surge.description: Additive file (schema 1): the Surge Watch catalogue. A surge = a match that ends `margin`+ shots above our expected total. Copied from the committed table src/shots/evaluation/surge_signals.json (generated from the over-shoot report); deterministic, no timestamp.

stacking.description: Additive (schema 1, 2026-10-28). Matches by number of applying boost signals, per route (research numbers, copied), and whether the 'strong surge candidate' label is used on the route.
